name: Get SMTP relay credentials
description: Call this when an agent needs the SMTP relay connection details (server host, port, and login identity) to configure an external application or mail client to send transactional email through Brevo. Use this only to read the connection settings; it returns no SMTP password or API key, so if a sending secret is required, obtain it from the SMTP & API key management area instead. For statistics on email already sent, use the transactional email statistics actions rather than this one.
preconditions: An authenticated Brevo web app session for the account is required.
The account must have transactional email (SMTP relay) available.

smtp_server.description: Hostname of the Brevo SMTP relay to connect to, e.g. "smtp-relay.brevo.com".

port.description: TCP port for the SMTP relay connection, e.g. 587.

login.description: Login identifier used to authenticate against the SMTP relay; observed as the account user's email address.

email.description: Email address of the account user associated with these credentials.

name.description: Display name of the account user associated with these credentials.
